method.model: The exact installed float32 voice model and its learned softmax mixture of all frozen encoder layers. One native 4 s forward per distinct PCM.
method.geometry: First paired fbank frame center is sample 280, then every 320 samples. Average frames by their centers in 20 successive 3,200-sample cells. Cells describe encoder timestamps; each feature may depend on the wider recording.
method.baseline: Original pooled clip logit and the existing affine head applied to the unrefitted cell vectors. The latter is a local inspection comparator, with no new learned parameters.
method.features: Use the per-cell hidden vector plus its difference from the recording-wide cell mean. Fit-only feature means and standard deviations, with a 1e-4 scale floor.
method.heads: Three L2-regularized linear heads (0.035). Balance positive and negative sample overlap mass. Fit on only matched splice triples, dry only for clean_head and all noise conditions for mixture_head and paired_head.
method.paired_loss: The paired head adds weight 0.20 to logistic edited-over-genuine ordering inside the exact splice, and weight 0.03 to squared response difference more than one full cell outside it. Compare both ordinary controls.
method.local_decision: Select the highest mean across three consecutive cells, with earlier start for equal means. Each arm strictly exceeds its own maximum response across all genuine confidence_cal views, including unedited and background-only controls. No synthetic cases or selection outcomes set the points.
method.useful: At least 0.30 time IoU and 0.50 recall against the exact edit support. Retain threshold-free best range, oracle interval mean, matched-pair ordering, false flags, and inconclusive results.
method.gate: Future transfer only: at least four additional useful noisy held views on at least three pairs and two families versus the unrefitted frame arm; at most one extra noisy false pair, no lost dry useful pair, and zero held background-only flags.

tamper_checks: Rejected a changed PCM sample outside the exact edited interval.
Rejected a shifted output sample on the public temporal grid.
